Our Testing Process

Our peptides are independently verified at a leading Australian university via HPLC & mass spectrometry. Tested in Australia, not overseas.

Step 1

Synthesis

Peptides are synthesised in-house using solid-phase methods for maximum purity

Step 2

HPLC Analysis

Every batch is tested via high-performance liquid chromatography to verify purity

Step 3

Mass Spectrometry

Molecular identity is confirmed through mass spectrometry analysis

Step 4

COA Issued

A full Certificate of Analysis is included with every product shipped

Why Choose Australian Peptide Labs?

Every compound is synthesised in-house under strictly controlled conditions, verified by HPLC and mass spectrometry, and supplied with a full Certificate of Analysis. For Australian researchers, that means defensible purity data, a domestic supply chain, and complete traceability — without the wait, customs risk, or guesswork of sourcing from overseas.

Independently Verified

Purity isn't just our word — select batches are confirmed by an independent leading Australian university, analysed here in Australia, not overseas.

Dispatched in Australia

Stocked and shipped domestically in temperature-controlled packaging — no customs delays or border seizures, with priority delivery Australia-wide.

Full Traceability

Every order ships with a batch-specific Certificate of Analysis and lot tracking, giving your lab a complete, audit-ready paper trail.
